summaryText:
Hi,

Here is the end-of-day summary for 8 September 2026.
Total work logged: 10h 55m.

Tickets worked on today:

AEME-6282 — 
  Customers exploited multi-tab checkout to redeem and cancel rewards points on 22 UAE orders. 18 remediated via PC-48490. 4 remain with insufficient GCRM balance — partial redemption script prepared under PC-53503. (45m)

AEME-6499 — 
  Five UAE stuck orders investigated. Four now COMPLETED. One order remains stuck at SHIPPING_REQUESTED after partial cancellation failure. Parallel investigation launched for DB state, Kibana logs, and codebase trace. (35m)

AEME-6540 — 
  Two UAE orders with trade-in clawback processes stuck in RUNNING after Checkout.com declined card authorization. No reusable PC ticket exists. Remediation script pending user confirmation to re-trigger clawback payment. (2h 0m)

GMT-19192 — 

GMT-20796 — 
  Investigation was in progress with only a lock file present — no RCA content generated. DB state verification and Kibana log analysis remain pending. Next step is to complete the investigation. (45m)

PC-53768 — Script to copy paymentInfo to clawback PaymentTransaction and retrigger ClawbackProcess
  No RCA file was found for this ticket. Investigation had not been started. Next step is to fetch the ticket details and begin the investigation workflow. (1h 0m)

RT-702249 — 
  Investigation was in progress with only a lock file present — no RCA content generated. DB state verification and Kibana log analysis remain pending. Next step is to complete the investigation. (35m)

SAHME-3357 — 
  Fourteen ZA orders with SMC errors investigated. Eleven remediated after SMC team completed device and product mappings. Three remain stuck — A36 unmapped, invalid identity document, and invalid product ID. Awaiting SMC team. (1h 0m)

SAHME-3407 — 
  Investigation was in progress with only a lock file present — no RCA content generated. DB state verification and Kibana log analysis remain pending. Next step is to complete the investigation. (1h 15m)

SAHME-3409 — 

SAHME-3421 — 
  Investigation was in progress with only a lock file present — no RCA content generated. DB state verification and Kibana log analysis remain pending. Next step is to complete the investigation. (45m)

SAME-3958 — 
  SA sales report missing affiliate_name and multistore_verificationcode columns. SaSalesReport.groovy needs two new @ColumnMethod handlers. Infrastructure exists in type system. Code modification requiring build and deployment of sapreporting extension. (2h 15m)

SAME-3962 — 
  Eighteen SA-region orders with refund failures under investigation. Sub requested re-push of auto refund triggers or confirmation refunds won't fire. Parallel fan-out investigation launched for DB state, Kibana logs, and codebase trace.

Open tickets:

PC-53768 [To do] — Script to copy paymentInfo to clawback PaymentTransaction and retrigger ClawbackProcess
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

PC-53503 [To do] — Redeem rewards points (partial) for 4 AE orders - AEME-6282
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

PC-53529 [To do] — [SAM-24720] Create DB cleanup cronjobs for SMI cluster
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

SAM-24720 [Code Review] —  Update or create Cronjob for autocleanup
  Todo: Hi ~@email,
   Please find below details : 
SAP incident : https://me.sap.com/cases/002075129500011086542026/overview
Sa

Thanks,
Aryan
